items.title: Add smoke repro of review-window execution poisoning and the new pass/fail boundary
items.context: Replay the B-956f shape in flow-stability-smoke: pre-TEST reviewer executed terminal plus one post-TEST closeout executed terminal in the same identity group must PASS convergence after the fix but fails before it; two post-TEST executed terminals in the same group must still FAIL; a reused terminal with commandExecutions greater than zero must still FAIL in any phase. Real-world telemetry evidence: .lattice/story/actives/B-956f/process-events.jsonl round 18:10:20 window events at 18:25:19 executed 34090591, 18:36:10 executed 15aa0ab1, 19:02:20 executed 34090591 TEST phase.
items.userSees: Running the new flow-stability-smoke convergence case prints a passing assertion for the B-956f-shaped window (pre-TEST reviewer executed + one post-TEST closeout executed in the same group does NOT throw) and failing assertions still throw done_prepare convergence invariant failed for two post-TEST duplicates and for contradictory reused terminals

happy.desc: B-956f-shaped window (two pre-TEST executed groups + one post-TEST executed duplicate of a pre-TEST group + reused exec=0) passes assertDonePreparePassConvergence with blocking counter 0 and observable counter 1

edge.desc: Window with two post-TEST executed terminals in the same identity group yields blocking counter 1 and assert throws
Group whose only executed terminal is post-TEST (no pre-TEST baseline) yields blocking 0 and observable 0

adversarial.desc: Reused terminal reporting commandExecutions greater than zero keeps failing convergence regardless of phase (pre-TEST or post-TEST)

verificationEvidence.note: Case A in the B-f824 block replays the B-956f window shape (two pre-TEST executed groups, one post-TEST executed duplicate, reused exec=0) and asserts blocking 0 / observable 1 / assert.doesNotThrow; failed pre-fix (1 !== 0), passes on commit 50bf7d1b2f.
Case B asserts two post-TEST executed terminals in the same identity group yield blocking 1 and assert.throws(/done_prepare convergence invariant failed/).
Case C covers a group whose only executed terminal is post-TEST: blocking 0 and observable 0.
Case D asserts a reused terminal with commandExecutions=46 timestamped pre-TEST still fails convergence (contradictory reused blocks in any phase).

items.title: Split convergence counting into blocking post-TEST duplicates and observable review-window telemetry
items.context: In deriveDonePreparePassConvergence: keep field unchangedSuiteExecutions as the blocking counter but compute it as per-group max(0, postTestExecutedCount - 1) using facts.testEntryAt as the boundary, plus contradictory reused terminals with commandExecutions greater than zero in any phase; add a new observable field reviewWindowSuiteExecutions = per-group max(0, totalExecutedCount - 1) counted across the whole window so redundancy stays visible without blocking. Update DonePrepareConvergence type at done-prepare.ts:205, the transcript regex parser at :1077-:1097, the render line at :1666, and assertDonePreparePassConvergence which must keep asserting only on the blocking fields.
items.userSees: done_prepare PASS transcript renders the convergence line as convergence: metadataRollbacks=0 reviewerReattestations=N postTestReviewerReattestations=0 humanConfirmations=0 unchangedSuiteExecutions=0 reviewWindowSuiteExecutions=M successfulCloseout=1 and a B-956f-shaped closing reaches DONE prepare: PASS instead of convergence invariant failed

happy.desc: deriveDonePreparePassConvergence returns both counters: blocking unchangedSuiteExecutions counts only per-group post-TEST duplicate executed terminals plus contradictory reused terminals; observable reviewWindowSuiteExecutions counts whole-window per-group duplicates
donePrepareJsonResult parses the new convergence render line including reviewWindowSuiteExecutions into the JSON convergence block

edge.desc: Terminal timestamped exactly at facts.testEntryAt counts as post-TEST (>= comparison, same convention as postTestReviewerIdentityIds)
Transcript without a convergence line (older shape) does not crash donePrepareJsonResult and yields no convergence block

adversarial.desc: assertDonePreparePassConvergence still throws when unchangedSuiteExecutions is nonzero and never consults the observable field, so demoting blocking data into the observable field cannot pass the gate

verificationEvidence.note: deriveDonePreparePassConvergence returns both counters per the phase-anchored split (commit 50bf7d1b2f); B-f824 Cases A-D plus the updated base-case deepEqual assert both fields.
donePrepareJsonResult transcript-parse deepEqual (~:4686) updated to the new line shape including reviewWindowSuiteExecutions and passes.
Case C boundary sub-case places an executed terminal exactly at facts.testEntryAt and asserts it counts post-TEST (>= convention, matching postTestReviewerIdentityIds).

Parser uses optional group (?: reviewWindowSuiteExecutions=(\d+))? defaulting 0; the pre-existing old-shape transcript fixture at flow-stability-smoke:4684 doubles as the backward-tolerance test and passes.

assertDonePreparePassConvergence still throws on nonzero unchangedSuiteExecutions (Cases B and D) and its body never reads reviewWindowSuiteExecutions, so demoting blocking data into the observable field cannot pass the gate.

happy.desc: All strict convergence-line regexes in done-prepare-merge-rerun-smoke, done-prepare-auto-closeout-smoke, done-prepare-closure-heartbeat-smoke match the new render shape and their suites pass under lattice validate

edge.desc: rg over packages/main/src for convergence: metadataRollbacks= finds no leftover matcher expecting the old line shape

verificationEvidence.note: All five matcher sites updated to the split shape (merge-rerun :333/:496, auto-closeout :367/:1211, closure-heartbeat type+deepEqual); each smoke passed standalone on commit be017fb645, and node bin/lattice.js validate --json reported allPass=true.
Repo-wide sweep found no other strict matchers; flow-stability-smoke:4684 is the deliberate old-shape backward-compat fixture and :4794 is a source-scan doesNotMatch unaffected by the shape change.

Process fact contract verified after the semantics change; runtime:closeout_validation_terminal registry rationale describes event-field bindings and stays accurate under the split, so it was left unchanged.

items.title: Update the B-c163 convergence contract prose in the three decisions docs to the phase-anchored split
items.context: Scope reviewer gap (PLAN round 2): the sentence repeated unchanged-suite execution ... constraints remain independently blocking is duplicated verbatim in docs/requirements/decisions/done-prepare-automation-execution-plan.md, workflow-convergence-failure-remediation-execution-plan.md, and done-prepare-heartbeat-review-assurance-ux-execution-plan.md, and after this story it would describe stale unconditionally-blocking behavior. Rewrite that contract prose in all three files so it states: unchangedSuiteExecutions blocks only on per-group duplicate executed terminals at or after the current TEST entry plus contradictory reused terminals with commandExecutions greater than zero, while reviewWindowSuiteExecutions records whole-window per-group duplicates as observable non-blocking telemetry. The done-prepare-automation doc is the doc-of-record that already documents the sibling reviewerReattestations/postTestReviewerReattestations split this story mirrors.
items.userSees: rg -n "remain independently blocking" docs/requirements/decisions/ returns only prose consistent with the phase-anchored split, done-prepare-automation-execution-plan.md names reviewWindowSuiteExecutions as observable telemetry, and git diff shows the other two B-c163 docs untouched

happy.desc: done-prepare-automation-execution-plan.md describes the phase-anchored split for unchangedSuiteExecutions and names reviewWindowSuiteExecutions as observable telemetry, consistent with its reviewerReattestations split prose

edge.desc: rg across docs/requirements/decisions finds no remaining claim that repeated unchanged-suite execution blocks unconditionally, and the two other B-c163 docs remain untouched by git diff (no injected suite-counting prose)

adversarial.desc: docs-drift preflight and story_review scope re-check accept the updated prose without introducing contradictions with the reviewerReattestations split documentation

verificationEvidence.note: Commit 6cb0771072 rewrites the B-c163 contract prose: line 734 now carries the post-TEST qualification and a sibling bullet documents the phase-anchored two-counter split (B-f824, B-956f incident, >= TEST-entry boundary, contradictory reused blocking, reviewWindowSuiteExecutions observable telemetry) consistent with the reviewerReattestations split prose.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "remain independently blocking" docs/requirements/decisions/ && rg -ln "reviewWindowSuiteExecutions" docs/requirements/decisions/
verificationEvidence.note: Single remaining match carries the post-TEST qualification; only done-prepare-automation-execution-plan.md names the new field; git diff confirmed the two verify-only B-c163 docs are untouched.

Full routine validate allPass=true on the branch containing the docs change; docs-drift preflight runs again mechanically at REVIEW to TEST and story_review scope re-check accepted the narrowed CHK-004 interpretation (OQ-1 resolution).
